findings.explanation: CH-U001-001 restates the supported Facebook Like-button claim but then converts it into proof of an outcome that always occurs for every person without exception. PLAN-U001 permits no more than mechanistic strength, while SRC-U001-CLAIM-001 and SRC-U001-MECHANISM-001 support the feedback-signal description and a reason users may post or return, not a universal guaranteed outcome. SRC-U001-ATOMIC-016 expressly forbids guaranteed outcomes without explicit source support.

assessments.rationale: CH-U001-001 is presented as factual and names only the source-supported Facebook Like button, as confirmed by SRC-U001-CLAIM-001 and SRC-U001-ATOMIC-012. Its opening feedback-signal proposition is supported, but its absolute causal guarantee exceeds the mechanistic ceiling in PLAN-U001 and lacks support under SRC-U001-MECHANISM-001; SRC-U001-ATOMIC-016 specifically disallows that guarantee. PLAN-U001 requires no hypothetical framing, so the framing is adequate despite the claim-strength defect.
